findings.location: Header subtitle text ('We love being scraped!')
findings.issue: The light grey subtitle text has extremely low contrast against the white/light grey background, failing the WCAG AA 4.5:1 threshold for normal text.
findings.user_impact: Users with visual impairments or those viewing the site on lower-quality screens will find this branding/tagline text completely illegible.
findings.recommendation: Change the text color of the subtitle from light grey to a darker charcoal grey (e.g., #555555 or #4B5563) to ensure a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

findings.location: Breadcrumb navigation ('Home / Books /') at the top left
findings.issue: The light blue link text within the breadcrumb bar is placed against a light grey (#F5F5F5) background, which results in insufficient visual contrast (below 4.5:1).
findings.user_impact: Strains readability and makes auxiliary navigation difficult to use for users with low vision or in bright lighting environments.
findings.recommendation: Darken the blue link color in the breadcrumbs to a more accessible shade (such as #1D4ED8 or #0056B3) to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

findings.location: Star rating icons on all product cards
findings.issue: The yellow fill color of the active stars on the white background fails to meet the 3:1 contrast ratio required for graphical user interface elements, making the ratings hard to read.
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users cannot easily distinguish how many stars are active versus inactive, obscuring critical product review metrics.
findings.recommendation: Change the star color to a darker, high-contrast gold/amber shade (such as #B45309) and add a dark grey outline to both active and inactive star vectors.

findings.location: Book titles in the product grid
findings.issue: Book titles are aggressively truncated with ellipses (e.g., 'In a Dark, Dark ...', 'The Last Mile (Amos ...') after only one line of text, even though there is sufficient vertical space to display more text.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot scan and identify full book names directly from the category listing, forcing them to click into the product page just to read the full title.
findings.recommendation: Allow the book titles to wrap up to a maximum of 2 lines, and apply a consistent min-height to the title text container so the alignment of the prices and 'Add to basket' buttons remains uniform across all cards.
